title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Critique in Researcher, with Claude reviewing GPT drafts
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, documented controls and licensing statements are supported. Microsoft documents Critique as the Researcher default when Auto is selected, and the briefing distinguishes Frontier availability from the roadmap's general availability target.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Provider-level user or security-group assignments govern access to features relying on Claude across Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, including the roadmap's Claude-dependent Critique.
claims.quote: These assignments are applied at the provider level and enforced across Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio experiences. When access is limited by user or group membership, only the assigned users can use Copilot features or agents that rely on that AI provider.
